The same moment continues: the scan opens the form, and the camera moves from a close shot to over his shoulder onto the same phone. The props are continuous (right hand, then both hands, bag on his left shoulder).

From the form to the waiting area, with all three patients seated under the single-strip TV. The production 'before' fields cite 03-1, 03-2 and 03-4 and tie the three routes together. Ravi's bag moves to his lap and the phone stays in his right hand, both recorded.

Ravi, rightmost in 03-5, rises with his bag back on his shoulder and pockets his phone. See the page 04 note on keeping Raman and Priya to Ravi's screen-left.
